title: ホープフルSの後に・エデンへの道

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having conquered the Hopeful Stakes, Gold Ship finds herself adrift without a goal. Is there nowhere left for her competitive spirit to go?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides to pursue the art of putting decorative leaves into sushi boxes. Is that really what you want, Gold Ship?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, the Book of Secrets appears before Gold Ship, enlightening her of the path to Eden. The knowledge motivates her to gear up for the Classics in earnest.
